item.title: Attorney General Ellison files lawsuit challenging Trump Administration’s illegal rollback of fuel-economy standards
item.description:
Publication Date: October 02, 2026

Joins broad coalition of 26 states, counties, and cities in filing lawsuit against new NHTSA rule that weakens fuel-economy standards for new cars and light trucks, hurts consumers, economy, and the environment

item.title: Attorney General’s Office and Clearwater County Attorney’s Office secure conviction for second-degree murder
item.description:
Publication Date: October 02, 2026

Christyan Logan pleads guilty to second-degree felony murder following September 2025 killing of Tray McCollum in Bagley
